changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE chats ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, is_group BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, name VARCHAR(100), created_by_profile_id BIGINT, last_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ -- Nessuna FK verso profiles: directs-service non dipende dallo schema di core. -- L'integrità referenziale su created_by_profile_id è garantita -- a livello applicativo, non a livello DB. );
CREATE INDEX idx_chats_last_message ON chats(last_message_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
